summary: Ride‑hailing platform Rapido raised $240 million in a Series D round led by Prosus, valuing the company at $3 billion.

Tiea Connectors raised Rs 77 crore in a Series A round led by IvyCap Ventures, with participation from Jamwant Ventures and 8X Ventures, to expand manufacturing and R&D for high‑performance connectors.

STCH, a Bengaluru-based textile tech startup, raised $5.5 million in a pre-Series A round led by Omnivore with participation from Kae Capital and WVC to expand its AI-driven fabric R&D and manufacturing platform.

investors: Blume Ventures | CRED | Peak XV Partners
summary: Consumer AI startup Curious Digital (M) raised Rs 102 crore in a seed round led by Peak XV Partners with participation from Blume Ventures and CRED.

summary: GobbleCube, an AI-driven SaaS platform for digital commerce, raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Susquehanna Venture Capital, with participation from InfoEdge Ventures and Kae Capital.

TraqCheck, an HR tech startup, raised $8 million in a Series A round led by IvyCap Ventures with participation from IIFL Fintech Fund to expand its AI‑driven background screening and sourcing agents in Europe.

Pluckk, a digital-first fresh food and clean-label FMCG brand, raised Rs 100 crore in a Series A round led by Euro Gulf Investment to expand offline retail, enter international markets, and enhance its AI-driven supply chain.

Leverage Edu, a study-abroad platform, is set to raise around Rs 200 crore (~$24 million) in a Series D round comprising equity led by Aditum Fund and venture debt from IDFC FIRST Bank, valuing the company at about $300 million.
Skyroot Aerospace raised $60 million in a growth-stage round co-led by Sherpalo Ventures and GIC, propelling the company into the unicorn club.
Travel fintech firm Scapia raised $63 million in a growth-stage round led by General Catalyst.
IndiGo Ventures Fund invested approximately Rs 10 crore in Sarla Aviation, an eVTOL air-taxi startup, to support its operating and expansion needs.
PhysicsWallah approved a Rs 120 crore equity investment into its wholly-owned NBFC subsidiary FinZ Finance to fund working capital and expansion of its financial services business.

summary: The Hosteller raised Rs 150 crore (approximately $16 million) from a group of investors including PROMAFT Partners and V3 Ventures.
Physis Capital announced the final close of its maiden Rs 400 crore fund, targeting investments in startups from Pre-Series A to Series B across sectors like consumer tech, fintech, and deeptech.
The Supreme Court upheld a 28% GST on online gaming firms, reviving tax notices totaling over Rs 1 lakh crore, impacting companies like Dream11 and Gameskraft.
Pine Labs reported Q4 FY26 revenue of Rs 700.5 crore and a profit of Rs 59.4 crore, marking its first profitable quarter.
KollegeApply, a Gurugram-based startup simplifying college admissions, reported over Rs 15 crore revenue and profit in its first fiscal year ending March 2026.
